name: northwind
description:
The northwind database stores salaries for the northwind company.
Northwind sells products to other customer companies and buys products from supplier companies.
Northwind employees manage orders and ship products via shippers to customers.

entities.name: categories
entities.label: Category
entities.description: Product catalogue groups. Categories form a hierarchy: a category may have a parent, so the same product rolls up into a sub-category and its root. Use the parent_of/child_of links to walk the tree and root_category_of/belongs_to_root to jump straight to the top level.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.label: Id
attributes.comment: A surrogate primary key that uniquely identifies a category.
attributes.description: Stable across renames of the category; use it for grouping rather than the name.

attributes.name: category_name
attributes.label: Name
attributes.comment: Name of a category
attributes.description: Short catalogue name such as 'Beverages' or 'Seafood'; unique in practice but not enforced.

attributes.name: description
attributes.label: Description
attributes.comment: Description of a category
attributes.description: Free prose about what belongs in the category; useful as context for a human, not for filtering.

attributes.name: picture
attributes.label: Picture
attributes.comment: A picture to visualize the category
attributes.description: Binary image data. Selecting it in a query transfers the whole blob — usually not what you want.

entities.name: customers
entities.label: Customer
entities.comment: Contains information about the company's customers, with fields like company_name, contact_name.
entities.description: The companies Northwind sells to. One row per company, not per person — the contact fields describe a single named person at that company. Country and city are free text and are matched by name against the countries lookup for map visualisations.

attributes.name: customer_id
attributes.label: Id
attributes.comment: A surrogate primary key used to uniquely identify each customer.
attributes.description: A five-letter code derived from the company name, not a running number; it appears in the order header as the link to this customer.

attributes.name: company_name
attributes.label: Name
attributes.comment: The cusomers company name
attributes.description: The legal company name and the label normally shown in reports.

attributes.name: contact_name
attributes.label: Contact
attributes.comment: Name of a contact person
attributes.description: One named person at the company; the table holds no further contacts.

attributes.name: contact_title
attributes.label: Title
attributes.comment: The title or role the contact person has in the customer company (e.g. Owner, Sales Representative, Marketing Manager).
attributes.description: Free text, so the same role appears in several spellings — group with care.

attributes.name: address
attributes.label: Address
attributes.comment: The first address line of the customer.
attributes.description: Street and number as one line; there is no second address line.

attributes.name: city
attributes.label: City
attributes.comment: The city of the customer address.
attributes.description: Free text and not normalised — the same city may occur with different spellings.

attributes.name: region
attributes.label: Region
attributes.comment: The region of the customer address.
attributes.description: State or province, and often empty outside North America.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.label: Postal code
attributes.comment: The postal code of the customer address.
attributes.description: Format follows the country and is therefore not comparable across countries.

attributes.name: country
attributes.label: Country
attributes.comment: The country of the customer address.
attributes.description: Written as in the source data ('UK', 'USA'), which is how it joins the countries lookup.

attributes.name: phone
attributes.label: Phone
attributes.comment: The telephone number to call the contact person.
attributes.description: Includes national formatting and separators; not normalised for dialling.

attributes.name: mail
attributes.label: Mail
attributes.comment: The mail of the contact person.
attributes.description: Contact address of the named person, not a general company inbox.

entities.name: customer_customer_demo
entities.label: Customer-Demo
entities.comment: Stores the relationships between customer and costomer demographics.
entities.description: Junction table assigning customers to segments. A customer can carry several segments and a segment many customers, so counting customers over this table double-counts unless the query aggregates distinctly.

attributes.name: customer_id
attributes.label: Customer Id
attributes.comment: A foreign key identifying the customer.
attributes.description: Half of the composite key; together with the segment it forms one assignment.

attributes.name: customer_type_id
attributes.label: Type-Id
attributes.comment: A foreign key identifying the customer demographic.
attributes.description: The other half of the composite key, pointing at the segment catalogue.

entities.name: customer_demographics
entities.label: Customer Demographics
entities.comment: A customer democraphics describes customer segments, e.g. Retail, Wholesale, Corporate, etc.
entities.description: The segment catalogue itself. Small and slow-moving: it names the segments customers are assigned to, without any customer data of its own.

attributes.name: customer_desc
attributes.label: Description
attributes.comment: A description to the customer demographic.
attributes.description: Names the segment, e.g. retail or wholesale; this is the value shown in reports.

entities.name: employees
entities.label: Employee
entities.comment: Stores employee information, such as their names and titles.
entities.description: Northwind staff who take and process orders. The table is self-referencing: reports_to points to the supervisor, so the management chain can be walked in either direction. Working hours and break minutes describe the daily schedule, not per-order effort.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.comment: A surrogate primary key used to uniquely identify each employee.
attributes.description: Also the target of reports_to, so the same key appears twice in the management hierarchy.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.label: Last Name
attributes.comment: Last name of employee.
attributes.description: Family name; combine with the first name for a display label, as neither is unique on its own.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.label: First Name
attributes.comment: First name of employee.
attributes.description: Given name.

attributes.name: title
attributes.label: Title
attributes.comment: The title or role the employee has in the company
attributes.description: Job title such as 'Sales Representative'; free text and not a controlled list.

attributes.name: title_of_courtesy
attributes.label: Courtesy
attributes.comment: The employees courtesy
attributes.description: Salutation such as Mr., Ms. or Dr.; purely for addressing the person.

attributes.name: birth_date
attributes.label: Date of Birth
attributes.comment: The employees date of birth.
attributes.description: Date only, no time; age must be derived against a reference date.

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.label: Hire Date
attributes.comment: The date the employee was hired.
attributes.description: Start of employment; together with the birth date it gives the age at hiring.

attributes.name: working_hour_from
attributes.label: Workinghour from
attributes.comment: Workinghour from.
attributes.description: Daily start time, stored as a time of day without a date.

attributes.name: working_hour_to
attributes.label: Workinghour to
attributes.comment: Workinghour to.
attributes.description: Daily end time; with the start time and the break it yields the net working time.

attributes.name: break_minutes
attributes.label: Break minutes
attributes.comment: Break minutes.
attributes.description: Unpaid break in minutes, to be subtracted from the span between start and end.

attributes.name: address
attributes.label: Address
attributes.comment: The address line of the employee.
attributes.description: Private address of the employee, not a company location.

attributes.name: city
attributes.label: City
attributes.comment: The city of the employee address
attributes.description: City of the private address.

attributes.name: region
attributes.label: Region
attributes.comment: The region of the employee address.
attributes.description: State or province of the private address; often empty.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.label: Postal Code
attributes.comment: The postal code of the employee address.
attributes.description: Postal code of the private address.

attributes.name: country
attributes.label: Country
attributes.comment: The country of the employee address
attributes.description: Country of the private address.

attributes.name: home_phone
attributes.label: Phone
attributes.comment: The telephone number of the employee.
attributes.description: Private number; the internal extension is held separately.

attributes.name: extension
attributes.label: Extension
attributes.comment: The internal telephone extension of the employee.
attributes.description: The internal telephone extension, up to four characters — not a supplementary note.

attributes.name: photo
attributes.label: Phota
attributes.comment: The portrait photo of the employee
attributes.description: Binary image data; transferring it in a query is rarely intended.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.label: Notes
attributes.comment: Notes to the employee
attributes.description: Longer prose on background and career; free text.

attributes.name: photo_path
attributes.label: Path
attributes.comment: Path or URL to the photo
attributes.description: Where the picture lives, as a path or URL; the file itself is not part of the database.

entities.name: employee_territories
entities.label: Employee-Territory
entities.comment: Stores the relationships between employees and territories.
entities.description: Junction table assigning employees to sales territories. Both sides are many, so an employee covering several territories appears several times here.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.label: Employee Id
attributes.comment: A foreign key identifying the employee.
attributes.description: Half of the composite key of the assignment.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.label: Territory Id
attributes.comment: A foreign key identifying the territory.
attributes.description: The other half; together they make an employee responsible for a territory.

entities.name: orders
entities.label: Order
entities.comment: Holds records of customer orders, including OrderID, OrderDate, and CustomerID.
entities.description: The order header: who ordered, when, where it ships and what the carriage cost. Amounts of the order itself are not here — they live in the line items. The four dates (ordered, required, shipped, delivered) let lead times and delays be measured against one another.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.label: Id
attributes.comment: A surrogate primary key used to uniquely identify each order.
attributes.description: Running order number; it is what the line items refer back to.

attributes.name: customer_id
attributes.label: Customer
attributes.comment: A foreign key identifying the customer.
attributes.description: Points at the customer who placed the order; the same_customer link joins to the customer record.

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.label: Order Date
attributes.comment: The date the order was placed.
attributes.description: When the order was placed — the usual reference point for period comparisons.

attributes.name: required_date
attributes.label: Required Date
attributes.comment: The date the customer requires the order
attributes.description: The delivery date the customer asked for; comparing it with the delivery shows whether the promise was kept.

attributes.name: shipped_date
attributes.label: Shipped Date
attributes.comment: The date the order is shipped.
attributes.description: When the goods left the warehouse; empty while the order is still open.

attributes.name: delivered_date
attributes.label: Delivered Date
attributes.comment: The date the order was delivered.
attributes.description: When the goods reached the customer; the gap to the shipping date is the transit time.

attributes.name: ship_via
attributes.label: Via
attributes.comment: A foreign key identifying the shipper.
attributes.description: Points at the carrier; the freight amount in this row is what that carrier charged.

attributes.name: freight
attributes.label: Freight
attributes.comment: The shipping freight.
attributes.description: The carriage charged for this order, as an amount — not a weight. It is not part of the line-item revenue and has to be added separately.

attributes.name: ship_name
attributes.label: Ship Name
attributes.comment: The name of the company to ship the order to.
attributes.description: Consignee on the shipping label; usually, but not always, the customer's company name.

attributes.name: ship_address
attributes.label: Ship Address
attributes.comment: The address of the company the ship goes to.
attributes.description: Delivery address of this order, which may differ from the customer's own address.

attributes.name: ship_city
attributes.label: Ship City
attributes.comment: The city of the company the ship goes to.
attributes.description: City of the delivery address.

attributes.name: ship_region
attributes.label: Ship Region
attributes.comment: The region of the company the ship goes to.
attributes.description: State or province of the delivery address; often empty.

attributes.name: ship_postal_code
attributes.label: Ship Postal Code
attributes.comment: The postal code of the company the ship goes to.
attributes.description: Postal code of the delivery address, in the format of the destination country.

attributes.name: ship_country
attributes.label: Ship Country
attributes.comment: The country of the company the ship goes to.
attributes.description: Destination country, written as in the address data and joined to the countries lookup by name.

entities.name: order_details
entities.label: Order Details
entities.comment: Links orders to products, detailing which products are included in each order.
entities.description: The line items — one row per product in an order. Revenue is computed here as unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount); the unit price is the price frozen at order time and may differ from today's product price.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.label: Id
attributes.comment: A foreign key identifying the order.
attributes.description: Together with the product it forms the key of the line; the same product appears at most once per order.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.label: Unit Price
attributes.comment: The unit price valid to the order.
attributes.description: The price agreed at order time; it is frozen here and does not follow later price changes.

attributes.name: product_id
attributes.label: Product
attributes.comment: A foreign key identifying the product.
attributes.description: Points at the product this line orders; the same_product link joins to the product record.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.label: Quantity
attributes.comment: The quantity of the order.
attributes.description: Number of units ordered of this product, in the product's own unit.

attributes.name: discount
attributes.label: Discount
attributes.comment: The discount to the order.
attributes.description: A share between 0 and 1, not a percentage — 0.15 means fifteen percent off.

entities.name: products
entities.label: Product
entities.comment: Stores details about products, including name, supplier, category, and unit price.
entities.description: The sellable catalogue. Stock figures are current values, not history, so they cannot be used to reconstruct past availability. Discontinued products stay in the table because past orders still reference them.

attributes.name: product_id
attributes.label: Id
attributes.comment: A surrogate primary key used to uniquely identify each product.
attributes.description: Stays valid after a product is discontinued, because past orders keep referring to it.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.label: Product name
attributes.comment: The name of the product.
attributes.description: Catalogue name as shown to customers.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.label: Category
attributes.comment: A foreign key identifying the category.
attributes.description: Points at the catalogue group the product belongs to; the same_category link joins to the category record.

attributes.name: quantity_per_unit
attributes.label: Quantity per Unit
attributes.comment: The quantity per unit the product is sold.
attributes.description: Describes the packing as free text, e.g. '24 - 12 oz bottles'; not a number and not usable for arithmetic.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.label: Unit price
attributes.comment: The unit price the product is sold before discount.
attributes.description: The current list price; historical revenue must use the price stored on the line item.

attributes.name: units_in_stock
attributes.label: in Stock
attributes.comment: The units in stock.
attributes.description: Current stock level, without history.

attributes.name: units_on_order
attributes.label: in Order
attributes.comment: The units on order.
attributes.description: Units ordered from the supplier but not yet received.

attributes.name: reorder_level
attributes.label: Reoder Level
attributes.comment: Minimum units on stock before ordering new products.
attributes.description: The threshold at which reordering is due; compare it with the stock to find gaps.

attributes.name: discontinued
attributes.label: Discontinued
attributes.comment: Signs whether the product is discontinued
attributes.description: Marks products no longer sold; they remain in the catalogue for historical orders.

entities.name: region
entities.label: Region
entities.comment: The region products are sold to.
entities.description: The coarsest level of the sales geography: territories belong to a region, and employees reach customers through territories.

attributes.name: region_id
attributes.label: Id
attributes.comment: A surrogate primary key used to uniquely identify each region.
attributes.description: Small key set — there are only a handful of regions.

attributes.name: region_description
attributes.label: Description
attributes.comment: A description to the region.
attributes.description: The region name, e.g. Eastern or Western; note the trailing blanks in the source data.

entities.name: shippers
entities.label: Shipper
entities.description: The carriers that deliver orders. Referenced from the order header via ship_via; the freight amount there is what this carrier charged.

attributes.name: shipper_id
attributes.label: Id
attributes.comment: A surrogate primary key used to uniquely identify each shipper.
attributes.description: Referenced from the order header via ship_via.

attributes.name: company_name
attributes.label: Name
attributes.comment: The name of the shipping company.
attributes.description: Name of the carrier as it appears in reports.

attributes.name: phone
attributes.label: Phone
attributes.comment: The telephone number.
attributes.description: Contact number of the carrier.

entities.name: suppliers
entities.label: Supplier
entities.comment: Stores information about suppliers delivering products.
entities.description: The companies Northwind buys from. Each product has exactly one supplier, so supplier-level figures are obtained by aggregating over products.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.comment: A surrogate primary key used to uniquely identify each supplier.
attributes.description: Each product carries exactly one of these, so supplier figures come from aggregating products.

attributes.name: company_name
attributes.label: Name
attributes.comment: The name of the suppliers company.
attributes.description: Name of the supplying company.

attributes.name: contact_name
attributes.label: Contact
attributes.comment: The name of the person to get in contact to the supplier.
attributes.description: The named person to approach at the supplier.

attributes.name: contact_title
attributes.label: Title
attributes.comment: The title or role of the person to get in contact to the supplier.
attributes.description: Role of that person; free text.

attributes.name: address
attributes.label: Address
attributes.comment: Address of the contact person.
attributes.description: Street address of the supplier.

attributes.name: city
attributes.label: City
attributes.comment: City of the contact person.
attributes.description: City of the supplier address.

attributes.name: region
attributes.label: Region
attributes.comment: Region of the supplier.
attributes.description: State or province of the supplier address; often empty.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.label: Postal Code
attributes.comment: Postal code of the supplier.
attributes.description: Postal code of the supplier address.

attributes.name: country
attributes.label: Country
attributes.comment: Country for the supplier.
attributes.description: Country of the supplier, in the same spelling used for customers.

attributes.name: phone
attributes.label: Phone
attributes.comment: Telephone number of the contact person.
attributes.description: Contact number at the supplier.

attributes.name: mail
attributes.label: Mail
attributes.comment: Mail of the company.
attributes.description: Contact address at the supplier.

attributes.name: homepage
attributes.label: Homepage
attributes.comment: Homepage of the supplier company.
attributes.description: Web address; free text and sometimes carrying markup from the source data.

entities.name: territories
entities.label: Territory
entities.description: Sales territories, the middle level between region and employee. Territory names are US city and area names.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.label: Id
attributes.comment: A surrogate primary key used to uniquely identify each territory.
attributes.description: Held as text, not a number, and padded in the source data.

attributes.name: territory_description
attributes.label: Description
attributes.comment: Description of the territory.
attributes.description: Name of the territory, usually a US city or district; trailing blanks in the source data.

entities.name: us_states
entities.label: US States
entities.description: Lookup of US states, used to resolve the state abbreviations that appear in address regions.

attributes.name: state_id
attributes.label: Id
attributes.comment: A surrogate primary key used to uniquely identify each state.
attributes.description: Key of the state lookup.

attributes.name: state_name
attributes.label: Name
attributes.comment: The name of the US state.
attributes.description: Full state name, resolving the abbreviations found in address regions.

entities.name: countries
entities.label: Country
entities.comment: Countries referenced by customer, supplier, employee and order shipping addresses, with geographic coordinates and outline for map visualisations.
entities.description: Geographic lookup joined by country name, not by a foreign key — the address fields hold free text such as 'UK' or 'USA'. It supplies coordinates and outlines so results can be drawn on a map.

attributes.name: country_name
attributes.label: Name
attributes.comment: The country name as used in the address columns (e.g. 'Germany', 'UK', 'USA').
attributes.description: The join key to the address fields — matched by name, so spelling must agree exactly.

attributes.name: iso_code
attributes.label: ISO Code
attributes.comment: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country.
attributes.description: Two-letter code, useful for stable labelling independent of spelling.

attributes.name: continent
attributes.label: Continent
attributes.comment: The continent the country belongs to.
attributes.description: Groups countries for coarse regional roll-ups.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.label: Latitude
attributes.comment: Latitude of the country label point (centroid), in degrees.
attributes.description: Degrees, positive north of the equator; the label point, not the geometric centre.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.label: Longitude
attributes.comment: Longitude of the country label point (centroid), in degrees.
attributes.description: Degrees, positive east of Greenwich.

attributes.name: geometry
attributes.label: Geometry
attributes.comment: Simplified country outline as a GeoJSON (Multi)Polygon, for choropleth maps.
attributes.description: Simplified outline as GeoJSON text; large, and meant for drawing rather than for filtering.

links.name: same_product
links.comment: both tables refer to the same product data record
links.description: Joins a line item to the product it sells.

links.name: same_customer_demographic
links.comment: both tables refer to the same customer-demographic data record
links.description: Joins an assignment row to the segment catalogue.

links.name: same_shipper
links.comment: both tables refer to the same shipper data record
links.description: Joins the order header to the carrier that delivered it.

links.name: root_category_of
links.comment: The category is the topmost root category of the second category
links.description: Jumps straight to the top of the category tree, skipping the intermediate levels.

links.name: belongs_to_root
links.comment: The category is a direct or indirect subcategory for the second category (root category)
links.description: The reverse direction: from any category to its root, however deep it sits.

links.name: same_supplier
links.comment: both tables refer to the same supplier data record
links.description: Joins a product to the company that supplies it.

links.name: same_employee
links.comment: both tables refer to the same employee data record
links.description: Joins an order or a territory assignment to the member of staff.

links.name: same_territory
links.comment: both tables refer to the same territory data record
links.description: Joins an assignment row to the territory catalogue.

links.name: same_customer_customer_demo
links.comment: both tables refer to the same customer-demographic data record
links.description: Joins the customer side of the segment assignment.

links.name: same_us_state
links.comment: both tables refer to the same state data record
links.description: Resolves a state abbreviation in an address to the state entry.

links.name: same_region
links.comment: both tables refer to the same region data record
links.description: Joins a territory to the region it belongs to.

links.name: same_order_detail
links.comment: both tables refer to the same order-detail data record
links.description: Joins back from a product to the line items that sold it.

links.name: reports_to
links.comment: the first employee reports to the second employee.
links.description: Upwards in the hierarchy: from an employee to the supervisor. Use the optional form, because the top of the chain has none.

links.name: supervisor_of
links.comment: the first employee is supervisor of the second employee.
links.description: Downwards: from a supervisor to the staff reporting to them.

links.name: parent_of
links.comment: this first category is a supercategory of the second.
links.description: One level up the category tree.

links.name: child_of
links.comment: this first category is a subcategory of the second.
links.description: One level down the category tree.

links.name: same_employee_territory
links.comment: both tables refer to the same territory data record
links.description: Joins to the employee-territory assignment.

links.name: same_category
links.comment: both tables refer to the same category data record
links.description: Joins a product to its category.

links.name: same_order
links.comment: both tables refer to the same order data record
links.description: Joins a line item to its order header.

links.name: same_customer
links.comment: both tables refer to the same customer data record
links.description: Joins an order to the customer who placed it.

links.name: same_country
links.comment: both tables refer to the same country data record; address country and order ship-to country reference the countries lookup by name
links.description: Joins an address or ship-to country to the geographic lookup — by name, so spelling has to match.
